note: MM banks with tools/kb_add.py from the repo tip; 2 entries are new to the Library

entries.name: Hydra-MDP
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Per-vocabulary-entry BCE on offline PDM sub-scores (8,192 vocab) + softmax imitation; distilling the AGGREGATE PDMS scores 80.2 vs per-sub-score 83.0, weighted-confidence inference 85.7, +EP target 86.5 PDMS navtest (NAVSIM v1).

entries.name: Hydra-MDP++
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Expert-guided extension of Hydra multi-target distillation; cited only as GTRS/DriveSuprim baseline (not read in depth).

entries.name: GTRS
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Hydra-style BCE scorer trained on a 16,384 super-dense vocab with 50 % vocabulary dropout; scores unseen diffusion proposals zero-shot (navhard EPDMS 36.7 vs random 25.6); dropout 43.4; ensemble 49.4 EPDMS navhard; NAVSIM v2 challenge winner.

entries.name: DriveSuprim
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Coarse-to-fine: BCE+imitation over vocab, top-k filtering into a refinement decoder trained on hard negatives, EMA-teacher soft labels; own top-K oracle 91.9/94.5/96.1 PDMS at K=1/4/16; ablation 81.4 -> 83.1 EPDMS navtest.

entries.name: WoTE
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Reward model reads BEV-world-model-predicted future states; trained with simulator sub-score targets + imitation reward; 88.3 PDMS navtest; ablation imi-only 83.5 / sim-only 83.6 / both 85.6.

entries.name: ZTRS / EPO
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Exhaustive Policy Optimization: one-step offline policy gradient summed over ALL 16,384 actions with advantage = normalised EPDMS minus an EC-consistency penalty on the previous pick; no human data; navtest EPDMS 85.3 vs IL 86.2 (EP 84.1 vs 88.5); argmax-EPDMS imitation 76.7.

entries.name: CaRL
entries.source: downloaded https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.17838 2026-11-07, NOT yet in Library
entries.finding: PPO privileged planner, reward = route completion with terminations and multiplicative soft penalties; dense shaped (Roach) reward falls into a 'not driving' local minimum at large mini-batch; nuPlan Val14 CLS 91.3 NR / 90.6 R; 500M samples on one 8-GPU node.

entries.name: PDM-Closed
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: 15 IDM proposals (5 target speeds x 3 lateral offsets), constant-velocity forecasts, LQR simulation, nuPlan-metric scoring, argmax; Val14 CLS-R 92 / CLS-NR 93 (OLS 42).

entries.name: TrajHF
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: RLHF for driving-style personalisation; NAVSIM 94.3 is the PDMS-selector (ground-truth-scored, oracle) row, not a deployable selector.

entries.name: RAD
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: PPO in 3DGS digital twins with collision + position/heading deviation rewards plus an IL regulariser; collision rate 0.089 (RL+IL) vs 0.229 (IL), own closed-loop benchmark.

entries.name: Gen-Drive
entries.source: downloaded https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.05582 2026-11-07, NOT yet in Library
entries.finding: Scene evaluator trained on VLM-curated pairwise preferences, RL fine-tune of a diffusion generator; nuPlan reduced Val14 0.8753 (fine-tuned) vs PDM-Closed 0.9121; over-optimisation: 1,000 steps 0.8753 -> 2,000 steps 0.8123.

entries.name: CLOVER
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Scorer re-fit on true evaluator sub-scores of the CURRENT generator's proposals; defines ranking regret = oracle - selected and validates with pairwise ranking accuracy 94.72 % (>=0.95 vs <=0.50 groups) and top-K enrichment; Stage1 94.13 -> Stage2 94.48 PDMS navtest (per RL_POSTTRAIN_REVIEW).

entries.name: DriveDPO
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Safety DPO over PDMS-ranked candidate pairs; rejected = imitation-closest unsafe candidate gives 90.0 vs distance-based 89.7 PDMS navtest.

entries.name: DrivoR
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: REFe's reference: disentangled scorer trained by per-sub-score BCE on its own proposals; navtest PDMS 93.1 (train) / 93.7 (trainval).

entries.name: TOAD
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: A fixed-vocabulary scorer (GTRS) used as a search reward drives iPad 34.7 -> 23.9 EPDMS navhard; DrivoR's disentangled scorer 49.8: scorer OOD exploitation is real.

entries.name: NAVSIM
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: PDMS definition; non-reactive one-plan simulation correlates better with nuPlan closed-loop CLS than displacement metrics (Spearman/Pearson, Fig. 4).

entries.name: Pseudo-simulation
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Two-stage pseudo-sim (EPDMS) correlates with closed-loop simulation at R^2 0.8 vs 0.7 for the best open-loop metric.

entries.name: DriveZero
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Privileged PPO teacher in mixed-agent nuPlan worlds; reward = hard-event penalty + goal bonus + (1/H) PRODUCT of six soft criteria; decomposed per-term critic + value-guided test-time reranking; camera student distilled from teacher rollouts: 95.3 PDMS navtest without human trajectories.

entries.name: NAVSIM score-basis audit
entries.source: copied from TanitAD Research Lab/Library (sha256 == library.json)
entries.finding: Abstract only: defensive-driving scores computed on shared reference rollouts can propagate rollout divergence; disclose the score basis and stack.
